notes.title: Update Notes: New Enemies, Custom Music, Updated Content, etc.
notes.notes:
- Added instruction manual to main menu. The manual has also been updated to reflect the current version of the game. (English only)
- Added functionality to support custom dungeon music. Check discussions for instructions or view official manual.
- Added new key bindings and functionality to look up and down at an angle.
- Added screen filter options to change the look and style of the game. This can be changed on the Main Menu and the Options screen in the dungeons.
- Updated most artwork to higher resolutions in the dungeons throughout the entire game for better visual quality.
- You can now look around during the intro boat ride.
- Updated some menu icons with new graphics.
- Redesigned the Options screen with universal icons and added the new options buttons.
- Added a couple of new enemies to some of the dungeons related to item lore.
- Health Flask can now temporarily be poisoned so if you use it, you will lose health instead of gaining health. You are notified when this happens with a visual and audio cue.
- Reworked how some treasure chests function. Some now have a lock on them that you have to destroy to open it.
- Added a new kicking functionality for treasure chests.
- Added an arm model to the shield model/animation.
- Added new death screen.
- Rewrote the custom key bindings code. Binding keys to mouse buttons is now supported.
- Added a sound effect if missing an attack on an enemy.
- There is now also an audio cue instead of just a visual cue when detecting a monsters weakness.
- Monster health bars can no longer be seen from far away. They now come into view as you move closer to a monster.
- Some Slime monsters have skeletal remains attached to them, those remains now have a slight animation to them.
- The Continue button on the Main Menu is disabled until you start a New Game if playing for the first time.
- Added the new monsters in the Collections on the Main Menu. (Not required to unlock trophy)
- Added an audio cue instead of just damage text when you do a critical hit to a monster.
- Water sitting in flask fountains now has a waving animation.
- Added a skip function to the credits screen so you can start Dungeon 11 faster.
- Cleaned up and simplified some internal code regarding language support.

Fixes:

- Fixed an issue where Shield and Daggers would sometimes not initialize when first loading Dungeon11.

As always, if you run any any issues, please report them in the discussions.

notes.title: Quick Update: 21:9 Support, Map Screen changes.
notes.notes:
1) Added better support for gamers using 21:9 ultrawide screens.
2) Adjusted the Map Screen and Map Screen Info boxes so they fade near the middle giving more visibility of the dungeons.

As always, if you run into any issues, please report them in Discussions or Email me directly.

notes.title: New Item, Increased Carry Limit, Completed Weakness System, Bug Fixes etc.
notes.notes:
1) Added a new item called Spore Orb. This item can be used during monster engagement to detect if they have weakness.
2) Added Weapon, Sidearm and Magic icons to the HUD that display a monsters weakness when using the Spore Orb.
3) Completed all the monster weakness / weapon functionality. Now Weapons, Sidearms and Magic can deal weakness damage to specific monsters.
4) You can now damage monsters when taking a step back and firing a Sidearm or casting Magic instead of having to stay in direct melee range.
5) Added Spore Orb key binding to Controls accessed via the Main Menu and Pause Screen.
6) Added Spore Orb icons and description to the Inventory Screen.
7) You can now carry unlimited Daggers.
8) Magic and Ammo carry limit has been bumped from 100 to 500 each.
9) Fixed Flame Boots description that was connected to wrong item. (Japanese description only)

notes.title: New Magic Functionality, Map Screen Additions, Bug Fixes etc.
notes.notes:
1) Added more detail to the Intro Dungeon, Dungeon 02, Dungeon 03, Dungeon 09 and Dungeon 10.
2) Fixed an unlocked door icon on Dungeon 03 that didn't show when it got unlocked.
3) Monsters now also show up on the Map Screen. They appear on the map as a pulsating red dot.
4) Reworked code on all levels to have better timing when unlocked door icons appear on the map. They now appear exactly when a door or gate opens, not any time before they start opening.
5) Added heat haze effect to candle flames in Dungeon 01. They should also have them just like torches do.
6) Added Monster listing to the Map Key List on the Map Screen.
7) Certain monsters now have weakness from certain magic attacks. If a monster is vulnerable to a specific magic it will now take double damage and x2 weakness damage if a critical hit. The Hit and Critical notifications for those will say Hit Weakness and Critical Weakness instead.
8) Fixed Death monster from not playing death animation due to an Interact Icon not being connected that get's removed when killing the monster.
9) Made some changes to the Map Screen. When finding a map, areas you have not visited yet appear darker and will turn brighter as you walk across them.
10) Trap chests are now random. You may or may not take damage.

notes.title: New Content, Changes, Build Updates, etc.
notes.notes:
Functionality:

1) File size optimization so the game download and install space is 1.2GB less. Going from 6.22GB to only 5.01GB.
2) Added Music and Sound Effect options to adjust the volume for each. This can be done from the Main Menu or within game on the Pause / Controls screen.
3) Added a Shield as an Off-Hand item. You can now block enemy attacks and projectiles in front of you. You will still take damage from monsters alt/strong attacks or if hit from behind or sides.
4) Added Throwable Daggers as an Off-Hand item. You can throw daggers anywhere at any time as long as you have them. Certain monsters are immune to them such as armored and shield carrying monsters.
5) Added footstep sounds when moving. Now various footstep sounds play according to the environment.
6) Added reverb audio to the atmosphere to give the game a more dungeon sounding quality.
7) Added Main Menu randomizer. Now the Main Menu will randomly choose a different background.
8) Rebuilt the Inventory Screen functionality. Now icons are highlighted when selected and supports both Mouse and Controller.
9) Added Mouse support for Language Menu selection. (missing from previous Menu Mouse Support update)
10) Added heart beat icon animation to HUD. Now you can also visually see through an icon that you are close to death other than previously just the heart beat sound and red health numbers.
11) Lessened the chance to miss an enemy when attacking.
12) Inventory screen SideArm category has been renamed to Off-Hand since now your Off-Hand doesn't only consist of a SideArm but also the Shield and Throwable Daggers.
13) Removed HUD displaying during intro cinematic.
14) In Dungeon04, Scorpion monsters will now poison you if hit with their stinger attack and will not sting attack you again until the poison wears off.
15) Added an audio cue for when you are close to finding a key.
16) Changed Fountain functionality when refilling flasks. You can now use fountain's multiple times for a total usage amount of 15 and they will only refill your flask to the maximum and subtract that usage from the fountain. Once all 15 uses have been distributed to the player, the fountain will then be disabled like before. Previously, fountains would always give you 15 flask uses regardless of your inventory count and if you didn't manage correctly, you could waste a fountain. For example, if you had 12 flask uses in inventory and you used a fountain, then you would only gain 3 to the maximum of 15 and all the rest got wasted. This is no longer the case.
17) Mouse cursor has been reverted to use your operating system's mouse cursor.
18) Some monsters now taunt you when they do damage to you.

Cosmetic:

1) Added mess stains to the Trolls underpants.
2) Replaced some low-poly assets with new hi-poly assets across the entire game.
3) Added burn marks on walls where torches are in some of the dungeons.
4) Added a lot of detail to the intro dungeon. (moon sky, howling wolf, sea creature, foliage, roots, dead rats in boat)
5) Added glowing eyes to statues in Dungeon03.
6) Replaced old low-poly assets with new hi-poly assets that reflect the lore in more detail in Dungeon03.
7) Changed some old key textures to higher resolution and to better match their description.
8) Updated and changed some textures that were lower resolution to more detailed higher resolution textures.
9) Dungeon01 has a new look and more detail.
10) Added blood stains under hanging corpses.
11) Added new monster to Dungeon01.
12) Added new alternate health pickup models.
13) Made the eye on the switch handles glow. Easier to spot now in some darker areas.
14) Added welcome sound effect when entering Dungeon02.
15) Replaced stone arches in Dungeon04 with a more detailed / better looking arch.
16) Dungeon04 has new texture art giving it more detail.
17) Dungeon05 has a completely new look.
18) Added more epic lighting, statues and roots to Dungeon10.
19) Added tortured souls sound effects throughout Dungeon01.
20) In Dungeon03 there was a spot where when you stepped left to dodge a Skeleton attack, you would step on spikes and be damaged. Those spikes have been removed so you can dodge without taking damage.
21) Added dead rats scattered around in Dungeon07.
22) Added 1 new monster that appears throughout every dungeon.
23) Slimes now have new weapon damage effects and a newly added attack debris effect. These needed replaced from updating Unity as they originally used old methods no longer supported.
24) Demon Lord monster in Dungeon05 now has a projectile attack.

Fixes:

1) Fixed some skull models that were stretched to wrong proportions of original size.
2) Fixed locked gate map icons that weren't displaying for some gates on Dungeon03, Dungeon07 and Dungeon10.
3) Fixed sorting layers for some monster health bars. Some of them were rendering on the same layer as wall torch flames.
4) Fixed unselected menu buttons not visually deselecting when using the Mouse to hover over another button.


Developer Side:

1) Updated developer tools from Unity 2018 to 2021. Doing so resulted in many changes and updates needed to be made across the entire game.
2) Game code needed rewritten to full C# and eliminated all Javascript as newer Unity versions no longer support Javascript.
3) Needed to reestablish all object connections on a per level basis since you can't just replace attached code / scripts of a different type and still have connections maintained.
4) All menu systems needed rebuilt from scratch as old methods used are deprecated and no longer supported in newer versions of Unity.
5) Some in game effects needed rebuilt as well since old methods used are also deprecated and no longer supported in newer versions of Unity.
6) Backported the console version to PC which was originally used in updating the game to Unity 2021. Everything removed from the PC version for the console port (mostly certain code / functionality) has been added back in along with the updated and redesigned menus.

As always, please report any problems you encounter in Discussions or preferred, send an Email as this was a lot of content that needed changed and added.

notes.title: Update: New Collections, Key Rebinding Menus, Trophies, etc.
notes.notes:
1) Added a Collections button and area to the Main Menu.
2) Added key rebinding menus to the Main Menu and to the Pause menu during gameplay.
3) Added Mouse functionality to Main Menu and in game menus.
4) Added 2 new trophies. (Add-On dungeon and collections associated)
5) Made some in game map updates to various icons when viewing the map screen.

There is now a new Collections button on the Main Menu. This new section contains models for the Monsters, Weapons etc. that are initially locked. They are unlocked by your first encounter with each unique monster or when finding weapons, items etc. When unlocked, they remain unlocked in which you can view these models at any time you want.

You can now rebind your keys within game from the Main Menu or during gameplay on the Pause screen. This makes changing your key configuration much easier.

There is now Mouse functionality on the Main Menu and in game menus. Previously you could only use the Mouse on the Inventory Screen but now you can use it on all menus to make selections.

There are two new trophies added for completing the Add-On dungeon as well as completing the Collections. Once you have unlocked all 61 models, the next time you visit the Collections on the Main Menu the trophy will unlock.

Made some changes to functionality and icons on the Map Screen. There is now better visual communication that shows if you have looted a chest, picked up an essential item etc. or not.

notes.title: Dungeons Of The Deep - Multi Language Support Update
notes.notes:
I have released the latest Dungeons Of The Deep update. This is a major update which contains Multi Language Support. Previously the game only supported English. It now supports 10 different languages.

Chinese (Simplified)
English (default)
French
German
Italian
Japanese
Korean
Portuguese
Russian
Spanish

If you come across any problems with this update, please let me know the details in the Discussions or email me.
